checks.detail: 10/10 categories have negative controls and at least three ablations
10 controls link lookup contrast and reporting columns

control_rows.simple_lookup_control: Retrieve one page or one sentence containing a relevant entity fact.
control_rows.negative_control: single-hop variant containing one required entity fact and no bridge requirement
control_rows.diagnostic_question: Does performance drop only when the answer requires composing both hops rather than retrieving either fact?

control_rows.simple_lookup_control: Find a document that contains the requested claim text.
control_rows.negative_control: current-only variant with stale snapshot removed
control_rows.diagnostic_question: Does performance depend on temporal/source-state control rather than claim-text retrieval?

control_rows.simple_lookup_control: Find the original paper body passage that states a relevant claim.
control_rows.negative_control: original-body-only variant where no appendix or lifecycle update changes the answer
control_rows.diagnostic_question: Does performance drop when appended material supersedes or qualifies the original body?

control_rows.simple_lookup_control: Extract a table cell or caption fact.
control_rows.negative_control: table-cell lookup variant whose answer is entailed by the cell alone
control_rows.diagnostic_question: Does performance depend on integrating table denotation with surrounding text?

control_rows.simple_lookup_control: Find a clear source that says a plausible answer.
control_rows.negative_control: single-authority variant where all cited sources agree and have equal authority
control_rows.diagnostic_question: Does performance depend on authority ranking rather than selecting the clearest prose?

control_rows.simple_lookup_control: Find a related fact or candidate evidence passage.
control_rows.negative_control: sufficient-evidence variant with explicit entailment for the answer
control_rows.diagnostic_question: Does performance distinguish related evidence from evidence that entails the conclusion?

control_rows.category: citation supports fact but not conclusion
control_rows.simple_lookup_control: Find a citation that supports a true premise.
control_rows.negative_control: premise-and-conclusion variant where the citation entails both fact and conclusion
control_rows.diagnostic_question: Does performance separate premise support from conclusion support?

control_rows.simple_lookup_control: Find a fact about a name, title, place, or abbreviation.
control_rows.negative_control: unambiguous entity variant with no same-name distractor
control_rows.diagnostic_question: Does performance depend on resolving the intended entity rather than matching surface form?

control_rows.category: temporal questions: as of date X
control_rows.simple_lookup_control: Find the most salient or newest relevant evidence.
control_rows.negative_control: timeless variant where the same answer is valid before and after the as-of date
control_rows.diagnostic_question: Does performance depend on applying the as-of date rather than retrieving the newest evidence?

control_rows.simple_lookup_control: Find documents that mention the topic.
control_rows.negative_control: consensus variant where all documents support the same conclusion
control_rows.diagnostic_question: Does performance identify contradiction instead of smoothing evidence into consensus?
